_comment: CSA Z94.2-14 / CSA Z94.2:18 regulatory values. All TODO_NORM items require Norm's confirmation before going live.

TODO_NORM_peak: Confirm 140 dBC peak limit applies uniformly across all jurisdictions listed above.

dual.TODO_NORM: Confirm dual formula: the +5 dB bonus is applied after derating each device by its own type factor and taking the better result. Verify this matches your copy of Z94.2 s.9.2.

derating.TODO_NORM_slc80: SLC80 derating formula not yet confirmed — stub only. Do not expose SLC80 input until this is resolved.

csa_classes.TODO_NORM_dual: Confirm acceptable HPD combination for Grade 5: any earplug + earmuff, or are there class requirements for each device in the pair?

adequacy._bands: over-protected: Lprot < 70 (blue); adequate: 70 ≤ Lprot ≤ limit (green); caution: limit < Lprot ≤ limit+3 (yellow); danger: Lprot > limit+3 (red)
adequacy._over_protected_note: Threshold lowered from 75 to 70 dBA. EN 458 treats 70–80 dBA as acceptable. Flagging 74 dBA as over-protected could pressure users toward inadequate protection.
